page.layout: One page of text: decorative ornament and title at top, introductory paragraph and italic note below, then two parallel tables (left: Genesis; right: Exodus above Leviticus); small printed signature "Yyy 3" at lower right of the tables; left-edge fragments of the facing page are not transcribed.

main_text.head: ALTER INDEX LOCORVM SACRAE SCRIPTVRAE.
main_text.p: In hoc occurrunt Testimonia Veteris & Noui Testamenti, quę ad veritatis confirmationem & errorum grauissimorum impugnationem citantur appositè, vel paulò prolixius explicantur, atque à falsis interpretationibus vindicantur.
NVMERVS prior caput: alter versiculum libri Scripturæ Sacræ: tertius & sequentes paginam huius Defensionis ostendunt.

page.notes: Table cells are set as in the print; the chapter numerals in the left column of the Genesis table and the Exodus table are partly illegible and their order was reconstructed from the surrounding rows. Several numerals in the Exodus and Leviticus columns are doubtful (e.g. 466 vs 466ˢ, 267 vs 267). The left-hand margin holds fragments of the facing page's index, which were not transcribed. The Leviticus heading and its rows are doubtful in the final column.
